requirements.text: The system shall support four user roles: Administrator, Project Manager, Analyst, and Guest.
The system shall allow Administrators to create user groups, manage user accounts, and reset passwords.
The system shall allow Project Managers to manage privacy policies, assign analysts to projects, and export project data to XML.
The system shall allow Analysts to create, update, delete, and view goals, scenarios, and requirements.
The system shall allow Guests to view repository information based on restrictions set by the Project Manager.
The system shall provide templates for goals, scenarios, P3P statements, EPAL rules, and access control policies.
The system shall maintain traceability links between goals and the policies from which they were derived.
The system shall support automatic multi-user analysis results comparison to identify classification differences.
The system shall calculate the Flesch Readability Score and Flesch-Kincaid Grade Level for policy documents.
The system shall allow analysts to define and manage access control elements and organizational structures via the RACAF module.
The system shall provide an interface to the Ponder policy editor for access control specification.
The system shall provide partial support for translating Ponder policies into Alloy specifications for verification.
The system shall extract and evaluate data-usage goals from P3P privacy policies against user privacy preferences.
The system shall provide secure storage of user passwords in the database.
The system shall provide a secure authentication mechanism for user login.
The system shall generate an access log for every add, delete, and edit action, including timestamp, user ID, action, and object.
The system shall ensure that multi-user analysis results are withheld from other analysts until their own classification is complete to prevent bias.
